plugins.name: newsletter-editor
plugins.description: Drafts a complete weekly newsletter (news roundup plus thought leadership article) from a rough drop file of notes and links. Turns you from writer into editor of your own publication.

plugins.name: b2b-landing-page
plugins.description: Plans and builds complete B2B landing pages — strategy, message hierarchy, section-by-section copy, form specification, visual direction, and the built page. Runs in two phases: a reviewable brief, then the build.

plugins.name: linkedin-infographic-builder
plugins.description: Turns an article, post or report into one polished 1080x1350 infographic PNG, styled by your design system, with your face and name in the footer. Built for B2B: proof over hype, one reusable idea per graphic.

plugins.name: linkedin-carousel-builder
plugins.description: Repurposes one long-form piece into a LinkedIn carousel: a 6-10 page PDF document post at 1080x1350 per page, styled by your design system, ending on a follow or subscribe CTA. PNGs of each slide come as a secondary output.
